description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and MRR@10 for different DPR models. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference (S), with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents MRR@10, with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot compares four lines representing different DPR models: DPR w/o query (black, solid line, no marker), DPR w/ corpus expansion (red, solid line, circle marker), DPR w/ document expansion (green, solid line, triangle marker), and another model represented by a blue line with an asterisk marker, though its label is not explicitly provided in the visible legend. The black line remains steady at approximately 34.3 across the x-axis. The red line starts at around 35.4 when S is 1 and increases to approximately 35.7 when S is 3, then remains relatively stable around 35.7. The green line begins at about 34.7 when S is 1, peaks at roughly 35.0 when S is 2, and gradually decreases to approximately 34.8 when S is 10. The blue line starts at around 34.6 when S is 1, peaks at approximately 35.1 when S is 3 and S is 5, and then declines to about 34.3 when S is 10.
